method: Direct inspection of rendered PNGs with view_image; source and caption cross-check against accepted FP64 data. Static HTML links checked; no browser-layout certification claimed.
checks: Common physical scale and fixed camera within each comparative 3D figure
Original points and actual live original bond segments; no generated surfaces or fragments
Three-node candidate bridge shown only while alive; final panel keeps identity highlights while explicitly marked split
Synthetic opening panel at 1.999750 ms is gold/gripped, not actual free; release at 2 ms deletes no material bonds
Contact arrows use declared 10 micrometres per micronewton display scale
Surface-bin bar denominators explicitly state all material nodes in each bin
Top-actuator force includes prescribed-motion inertia and is zero after grip release
All ten figures have readable titles, axes, units and legends/status labels at native output resolution
display_limits: Dense live-bond networks overlap at overview scale; candidate bridge has separate zoom
Scatter display ranges crop extreme kinematic values; full FP64 arrays retained
V3 overview omits interface and fixed-scaffold lines for visibility; graph analysis includes all typed bonds
Mixed-mode values are diagnostics, not calibrated critical skew or Gc
